params.name: query
params.description: The partial address or place to autocomplete.

params.name: near
params.description: Optional latitude,longitude to bias results toward.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results (default 10, max 100).

params.name: layers
params.description: Optional comma-separated layers to filter (e.g. address, street, locality, place).

params.name: countryCode
params.description: Optional ISO 3166 country code to filter.

params.description: Optional comma-separated chain slugs to filter (e.g. starbucks).

params.name: categories
params.description: Optional comma-separated categories to filter (e.g. food-beverage).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results (default 10, max 100).

items.docs: Searches for places near a location, filtered by chain, category, or Radar place group.
